target: NFDB agency-reported size >=10 ha conditional on eligible recorded fire
hypothesis: Pure seasonal and spatial controls clarify what the formerly named seasonal baseline actually measures.
interpretation: One deterministic fit per fold, no seed replication or hyperparameter search. Same eligible fires and preprocessing; differing input counts are declared feature-group controls, not an equal-feature selection contest. Report all conditions; do not select a new final model or infer causality. Intercept uses training prevalence.
